title: Pure Memento
summary: Pure Memento self-destruction combo deck with generic Link support. Retraining classic Normal Monsters into skeletal spirits, Mementos destroy each other to search, mill, and swarm the graveyard before summoning the 5000 ATK colossus Mementoal Tecuhtlica - Combined Creation.

summary.title: Starters
points: Mementotlan Angwitch adds any Memento monster from Deck to hand on Normal or Special Summon, and can destroy a Memento you control to Special Summon a Level 2 or lower Memento from the GY.
Mementotlan Dark Blade destroys a Memento you control to Special Summon a Level 3 or lower Memento from the Deck.

Mementotlan Tatsunootoshigo Special Summons itself from the hand if you control no non-Memento monsters, and destroys a Memento you control to mill Memento monsters with different names whose Levels total 5 or less.
Mementotlan Bone Party destroys a Memento monster in your hand or field to add or Special Summon a Memento monster with a different name from your Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Mementotlan Angwitch
steps: Normal Summon Mementotlan Angwitch to search Mementotlan Tatsunootoshigo from your Deck.
Special Summon Tatsunootoshigo from your hand using its own effect.
Activate Tatsunootoshigo's effect, destroying itself to send Mementotlan Ghattic, Mementotlan Goblin, and Mementotlan Mace from Deck to the GY.
Ghattic triggers upon being sent to the GY, Special Summoning itself and recovering Mementotlan Fusion or Mementomictlan from the GY.
Angwitch destroys Ghattic to revive Goblin or Mace from the GY, loading five different Memento names to Special Summon Mementoal Tecuhtlica - Combined Creation.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Mementoal Tecuhtlica - Combined Creation is a 5000 ATK boss that must be Special Summoned by shuffling five Memento monsters with different names from your GY into the Deck; it attacks all opposing monsters, triggers on opponent monster effects to summon a Memento, and locks down plays under Cranium Burst.

Mementomictlan Tecuhtlica - Creation King mills three Memento cards on Fusion Summon, can destroy cards the opponent controls up to the number of Memento monsters you destroy, and searches Mementomictlan if destroyed.
Mementotlan Twin Dragon destroys a Memento you control to search two Memento cards with different names from your Deck, and revives a Level 6 or lower Memento from the GY if destroyed.
Mementotlan-Horned Dragon Special Summons itself with three or more Mementos in the GY, and destroys up to three cards on the field if destroyed.
S:P Little Knight provides targeted banishment on Link Summon and a Quick Effect banish to dodge removal.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mementomictlan Special Summons a Memento with a lower original Level from Deck or GY when a Memento monster is destroyed, and Sets a Memento Spell/Trap from the Deck each End Phase.
Mementotlan Fusion is a Quick-Play Spell that fuses using monsters on field or hand, and can shuffle materials from the GY if a Memento monster was destroyed that turn.
Mementotlan Bone Party destroys a Memento in hand or field to search or summon another from the Deck, and banishes itself from the GY to grant piercing damage.
Mementotlan Cranium Burst forces opponent monsters to attack your highest ATK Memento monster and negates monster effects activated on field by reducing Combined Creation's ATK by 1000.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Hybrid variants featuring Fiendsmith or K9 engines are left out in favor of running the focused pure 2024 Memento lineup.

main: Mementotlan Tatsunootoshigo
Summons itself from the hand; destroys a Memento to mill Mementos up to its Level.
Mementotlan Angwitch
Summoned: searches a Memento monster; trades a Memento on the field for a Level 2 or lower one from the GY.
Mementotlan Shleepy
Summons itself the turn a monster is destroyed and Fusion Summons a Memento Fusion.
Mementotlan Ghattic
Summoned: returns a Memento card from the GY; summons itself when a Memento mills it.
Mementotlan Goblin
Destroys a Memento to mill two more; discards to shield your Mementos once Combined Creation is out.
Mementotlan Mace
Destroys a Memento to search a Memento card; discards to steal a monster on their turn.
Mementotlan Dark Blade
Summoned: discards to destroy a Spell/Trap; destroys a Memento to summon a Level 3 or lower one from the Deck.
Mementotlan Akihiron
Newest Main Deck card. Destroyed, returns a Memento card; comes back when another Memento is destroyed.
Mementotlan-Horned Dragon
Summons itself with three Mementos in the GY; destroyed, destroys three face-up cards.
Mementoal Tecuhtlica - Combined Creation
Shuffles five different Mementos back to summon a 5000 ATK boss that summons more on their turn.
Mementomictlan
Field Spell: summons a lower-Level Memento when yours is destroyed, and Sets a Memento Spell/Trap each End Phase.
Mementotlan Fusion
Quick-Play Fusion that can shuffle Mementos from the GY; from the GY, searches a Memento Spell/Trap.
Mementotlan Bone Party
Destroys a Memento to add or summon another from the Deck.
Mementotlan Cranium Burst
Continuous Trap: forces attacks into your Memento and negates a monster effect with Combined Creation.
extra: Three Mementos: mills three Memento cards, destroys a card for each Memento you destroy, and searches the Field Spell.
Two Mementos: destroys a Memento to search two; destroyed, revives one.
Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
